messages:
Sam: Opening a short PR to cover offline bundle signing & verification, plus a tiny systemd unit example for the offline installer service. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4350. Requesting docs + eng-runtime review.
Elena: 👍 Can you include a simple systemd unit and explain where to put the GPG key bundle on sealed sites? Ops teams always ask for exact paths.
Sam: Yep. Drafting the unit and a recommended layout. Snippet below.
Sam: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=Redwood Offline Installer
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-offline-install "--bundle=/opt/redwood/offline/redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz"
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
Sam: Recommended file hierarchy in docs: `/opt/redwood/offline/` (bundle + checksum), `/etc/redwood/keys/` (GPG public keys), and `/var/lib/redwood/state` (installer state).
Ravi: For HSM/PKCS#11 note, please add a tiny example for loading soft-pkcs11 mapping on air-gapped hosts: map logical alias -> slot ID so migrations are deterministic.
Sam: Adding a mapping example and a short JSON mapping file:```
# hsm_key_map.json (example)
{
  "logical_name": "project-root-key",
  "slot_id": "2",
  "label": "redwood-root"
}
```
Nina: Also include the verification commands we use in QA: sha256sum + gpg --verify example. Ops will copy these directly.
Sam: Added verification examples:```bash
sha256sum redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
# expected: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
# verify GPG sig (public key installed under /etc/redwood/keys/)
gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /etc/redwood/keys/redwood-keys.kbx --verify redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-2026.03.22.tar.gz
```
ops-bot: Anchor check: /private/offline#install-verify -> 404. Suggested anchor: /private/offline#verification-and-signing. Ran at 2026-03-22T12:02Z.
docs-bot: Linkcheck pass except the anchor noted by ops-bot. Also flagged an absolute URL to internal console in the migration doc; recommend `{{ REDWOOD_API_URL }}` placeholders.
Elena: Tiny nit: call out SELinux considerations in the unit (files under /opt and /etc). Some customers run enforcements by default.
Sam: Added a note: "If SELinux is enforced, label /opt/redwood/offline as installer_exec_t and allow read access to /etc/redwood/keys." Also added a short troubleshooting row for "bundle fails to verify" (check checksum, GPG key presence, clock skew).
Ravi: For PKCS#11 addendum, add a link to HSM compatibility page and recommend testing `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` during preflight.
Sam: Done. Linked to https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/hsm-compat.md and added pkcs11-tool example.
Nina: I'll do a quick pass for wording and then approve.
Elena: LGTM after wording pass. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks all — will merge once Nina approves and then post a short note in #eng-docs about the new offline verification section.
